about: Key moments for chapter 4, seeded by the project as a starting point.

jobs.prompt: Wide view from an outdoor courtyard cafe with a few tables of teenagers and older couples. In the foreground, the boy from reference image 1 sits at a table, gazing out through the courtyard entrance, while the boy from reference image 2 taps the table and holds up a hand device whose screen shows soft abstract glowing patterns. Across the street, visible through the entrance, a teenager stands at the top of a wooden ladder leaned against a lamp post, unscrewing a security camera and dropping it into a black pouch. Low-rise buildings with neon accents, warm daylight.

Wide establishing shot of a half-kilometer-tall pyramid rising at the edge of a low-rise city: a refurbished mountain clad in smooth stone with a square base, like the monument of an ancient civilization. Two rows of trees line a straight path running up its face to the halfway point, and another row of trees circles the pyramid horizontally at exactly half its height. In the foreground a lone young man, seen from behind, crosses the last street and starts up the sloping path toward it. Late afternoon light, glowing shop lights in the city behind.

Medium shot in a stone-walled room deep inside a mountain, entered through an arch of stone bricks. The young woman from reference image 1 stands close, resting a hand on the shoulder of the young man from reference image 2, wearing a teasing, confident smirk. He has turned half away from her, frowning, his fists clenched at his sides. In the background an older woman watches from a distance, her face in shadow. Polished stone walls with a rounded ceiling, warm indoor lighting, a tense rivalry.

Wide shot of a vast, dark underground hall with over a thousand spectators in tiered seats, faces lit faintly by a giant glowing display of abstract dotted patterns. A lit path on the floor leads to a large game console with a single chair. The young man from reference image 1 sits in the chair, tense and focused, while several drones the size of a hand device hover and circle around him, scanning him with thin beams of light. A tray beside him offers glasses attached to a long cable. Neon pink and cyan glow in the darkness.

Medium shot in a waiting room carved from polished stone, with elevator pod doors set into the wall behind. The older woman from reference image 1 stands calmly, hands folded, wearing a knowing half-smile as she explains something. The young man from reference image 2 faces her, his eyes wide open in astonishment. Off to one side, a young woman stands with her back partly turned. Warm indoor lighting, a quiet, charged moment just after a hard-won victory.
